dailyTips.title: Morning hydration tip
dailyTips.message: Drink a glass of water before applying skincare to boost absorption.

dailyTips.title: SPF is essential
dailyTips.message: Apply sunscreen even on cloudy days. UV rays penetrate through clouds.

dailyTips.title: Cleanse gently
dailyTips.message: Use lukewarm water and pat your face dry instead of rubbing.

dailyTips.title: Nighttime routine matters
dailyTips.message: Your skin repairs itself at night. Apply a richer moisturizer before bed.

dailyTips.title: Don't skip moisturizer
dailyTips.message: Even oily skin needs hydration. Use a lightweight, non-comedogenic formula.

dailyTips.title: Check your ingredients
dailyTips.message: Avoid mixing retinol with vitamin C. Use them at different times of day.

dailyTips.title: Hands off your face
dailyTips.message: Touching your face can transfer bacteria and cause breakouts.

dailyTips.title: Exfoliate wisely
dailyTips.message: Over-exfoliating damages your skin barrier. Limit to 2-3 times per week.
